items.lede: Global energy watchdog forecasts huge rise as US and China turn to fossil fuels to power AI growth agendas The world’s datacentres will create 70% more carbon emissions within the next four years as the US and China turn to fossil fuels to power their AI growth agendas, according to the world’s energy watchdog. items.title: Datacentres to create 70% more carbon emissions by 2030, IEA report warns

items.lede: IEA's report says that power production and distribution is barely keeping up with the rapid growth of AI data centers.
items.title: AI data center power demand will double by 2030 thanks to $4 trillion in spending, adding an entire Great Britain to energy strain
